versions.content: The Main Time Tuple shall only be updated • after setting a new Global Time or a new Rate Correction value by the application • after obtaining a Rx Time Tuple (i.e., a new Time Tuple) from a Timesync Module • after the Offset Correction By Rate Adaption interval (see [SWS_StbM_00353]) However, the Main Time Tuple may be updated if there has been no update for more than 3s.

If for a Time Base • a Disciplined HW Clock is not supported (i.e., StbMDisciplinedClock is not configured) • or a Fallback Virtual Local Time is configured (i.e., StbMFallbackTime- Clock is configured), when • for a Global Time Master – a new Global Time or a new Rate Correction value is set by the application (refer [SWS_StbM_00342]) – or a Time Base gets cloned from another Time Base (see [SWS_StbM_00534]) • or for a Time Slave – a new valid Rx Time Tuple is obtained from a Timesync Module (refer [SWS_StbM_00440], [SWS_StbM_00588], [SWS_StbM_00400] or [SWS_StbM_00356]) – or the Offset Correction by Rate Adaption interval has elapsed (see [SWS_StbM_00353]), then the StbM shall update the Main Time Tuple for the Time Base.
